# ATOF

> Open-source graph optimization interface designed for low-friction human and AI use.

## Start here

- atof ai — compact machine-readable capability manifest
- atof profile <graph> --compact — low-token graph summary
- atof optimize <graph> --engine portfolio --compact — practical portfolio result
- AGENTS.md — agent operating rules
- docs/ai-quickstart.md — AI-first interface contract
- docs/product-quickstart.md — product usage
- docs/benchmark-protocol.md — research protocol

## Semantics

ATOF currently exposes balanced, unweighted two-way partitioning. Portfolio selection is empirical on the available backends; it is not a universal optimality claim.
